top_reply.author: @honkhonk8009

Yea sometimes it does surprise you cus it read something and patched together stuff that no human would have the attention to actually comb over and care about. 

But thats precisely the biggest problem with AI too unironically. It focuses on reconstruction rather than remembering. An encoder doesnt remember trees as branches with leaves and a log between it. it remembers it as specific pixel positions and probabilities to later reconstruct the image.


And that also applies to the attention mechanism in LLM's too. It just sometimes hones in on solutions that you wouldnt think about. 

It kinda reminds me of Rocky from Project Hail Mary. Little to no spatial awareness but insane memmory to compensate. There was actually a few humans like that I saw on TV that had a smaller motor cortext and smaller visual parts of their brain, but in return they had more grey matter around the areas responsible for language and memorizing stuff.
